name: Project Development Objective
description: Headline outcome indicators for the AGILE development objective: enrolment, completion and examination performance for girls.

name: Component 1 - Creating Safe and Accessible Learning Spaces
description: School construction and rehabilitation, WASH facilities, school improvement grants, safeguarding and the whole-school approach.

name: Component 2 - Fostering an Enabling Environment for Girls
description: Community mobilisation and media outreach, life skills and safe spaces, digital literacy, second-chance education, scholarships and social safety nets.

name: Component 3 - Project Management and System Strengthening
description: Cross-cutting indicators: gender policy adoption, climate awareness, eco clubs and grievance redress.
